skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply urban economic theories to real-world problems.
Analyze land use patterns in urban areas.
Plan and assess infrastructure needs in urban settings.
Apply economic principles to understand crime patterns in urban areas.
Model urban growth using economic theories.
Evaluate transportation issues in urban environments.
Plan educational facilities and services in urban contexts.
Analyze housing markets in urban areas.
Develop and evaluate policies for urban economic development.
Conduct research on urban economic topics using appropriate methods.
Apply critical thinking to analyze complex urban economic issues.
Work collaboratively to solve urban economic problems.
Engage in independent study to deepen understanding of urban economics.
Communicate effectively about urban economic concepts and findings.
